title: Airwallex hero
description: A bright split hero: a bold geometric headline with two words in violet, a grey lede, a violet text link with a nudging chevron, an email field with the button tucked inside and a consent tick. On the right a wide 3:2 device-shot frame bleeds toward the edge and crossfades between three shots every five seconds while a pill-shaped dot fills underneath. Phones stack it: headline, field, full-width button, then the shot.
notes: the rotation is made for three slides (CSS only, 15s cycle); with fewer or more, only the first shows
slides are media slots: leave them out for placeholders
with reduced motion the first slide stays
